caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical object with a central vertical support mounted on a rectangular base supported by three legs. The object has a central circular mechanism from which six evenly spaced spokes radiate outward, each ending in a knob. The main body of the object is rectangular and vertically oriented, with the circular hub attached roughly at the center. The base sits on three outward-angled legs, each terminating in a rounded foot, giving the structure stability. The apparatus is rendered in shades of brown and tan, indicative of wood, with darker lines used to delineate edges and hardware. The drawing is framed by a single-line border, and the overall background is plain, allowing the focus to remain on the object.
title: Winding Wheel
